value.rationale: Holmsen–Lee use precisely this canonical subdivided-clique graph to illustrate non-top-dimensional nonmatching homology and prove link vanishing at >= 3k-4. Establishing that restoring its one original edge annihilates every degree-(3k-5) class gives a concrete sharpness obstruction to lowering their edge-inclusion stability range. This is a map phenomenon not determined by Betti numbers of the source alone, with a natural relation to the deletion-link long exact sequence; no broader theorem is asserted.
